title: Do Credit Rating Agencies Learn from the Options Market?
near_miss_reason: Option listing occurs at firm-specific quarters, but the only DiD (Table 3) is a PSM-matched event-window design whose coefficient of interest is the slope change edf_lead x olist x post (continuous x binary). 'post' is defined for matched control firms from their treated match's listing date (DID_rating_risk_responsiveness.sas lines 703-704), an extra treatment regressor (5b, mnsc.2023.4774). Violations beyond controls, so not a 5c near-miss.
eligible_reason: Table 3 regresses next-period rating on edf_lead, post, olist, post x olist, edf x post, edf x olist and edf x olist x post with year dummies and firm FE on a propensity-score-matched sample (cols 1-2: 12-month window; cols 3-4: alternative window). The estimand is a change in the rating-EDF slope (continuous interaction), post is a pair-level main effect for control firms, and the sample is matched on time-varying covariates. Tables 1-2 and 4-6 regress on the continuous options-volume ratio (vratio) with time-varying controls.
design_notes: Firm-quarter/year Compustat-CRSP-OptionMetrics panel. Main tests: areg nrating_lead on edf_lead x vratio (continuous), lagged firm controls, year dummies, firm FE. Table 3 DiD: treatment = firms whose options begin trading (olist=1), controls PSM-matched (psmodel on edf, vratio, leverage, ROA, etc.), post = quarters after the (matched) listing date. psmtest5_12m.dta: 6,345 obs, 544 firms (449 olist=1); psmtest5.dta: 3,853 obs, 589 firms.
estimators_reported: firm-FE OLS with continuous options-volume interactions
PSM-matched DiD with continuous triple interaction

specs.exclusion_reason: coefficient of interest is continuous edf_lead x olist x post; post defined for matched control firms (extra treatment regressor); PSM matched on time-varying covariates; cols 2 and 4 add time-varying controls
specs.controls: edf_lead and its interactions; cols 2,4: lev roa mtb tang sales lev_std_lag roa_std_lag

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment (vratio and its interaction with edf_lead), time-varying controls

data_provenance_note: Regression-ready .dta files (psmtest5_12m.dta, psmtest5.dta, nc391.dta, def_data.dta) built from licensed WRDS sources (Compustat, CRSP, OptionMetrics, ratings) are shipped with SAS construction code; no statement of synthetic or altered data.
screener_notes: Screened from package and abstract. eligible_design coded false because no reported specification has a binary staggered treatment as the regressor of interest without continuous interactions or pair-level post main effects; the lead may prefer eligible_design true on the strength of staggered option listing.
